test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The average of Sachin's marks in 7 subjects is 76. His average in six subjects excluding English is 70. How many marks did he get in English?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Average marks of 7 subjects = 76

Average marks of 6 subjects (excluding English) = 70

Deviation per subject = 76 − 70 = 6

Total deviation for 6 subjects = 6 × 6 = 36

English marks = New Average + Total Deviation = 76 + 36 = 112

**∴ The correct answer is 112.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average of 7 subjects = 76

Average of 6 subjects = 70

**Formula Used:**

Total sum = Average × Number of observations

Value of excluded item = (Total sum of all items) − (Total sum of remaining items)

 
 6 Subjects (Avg: 70)
 
 
 English
 
 
• 
 Combined Avg: 76
 
 Total Marks = (76 × 7) = 532

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total marks in 7 subjects = 76 × 7 = 532

⇒ Total marks in 6 subjects (excluding English) = 70 × 6 = 420

⇒ Marks in English = Total marks in 7 subjects − Total marks in 6 subjects

⇒ Marks in English = 532 − 420

⇒ Marks in English = 112

**∴ The correct answer is 112.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Definition

The arithmetic mean is calculated as: Average = (Sum of all observations) ÷ (Number of observations).

Inclusion/Exclusion Effect

When a new value is added, if the average increases, the new value is greater than the old average; if the average decreases, the new value is less than the old average.

General Formula for New Entry

New value = (New Average × New count) − (Old Average × Old count).</p
